## 5. Amortised cost per attestation (derived)

public placement: cycles(Attest) + cycles(CheckHeader) + consumer cycles (Statement + MarkConsumed for the ERC-20 consumer), plus Path A update gas / k attestations per header. Storage gas (wire bytes of the public tx) is not included here. Private placement: PRIVATE_VERIFY_GAS + public effects + PRIVATE_GAS_STOR, the Attest cycles move to the user's prover.
